ios.desc:
Find your people on Highrise. Dress up your avatar, play social games, and meet real players from all over the world with free voice chat. Over 50 million players have made friends here since 2014, with new fashion, events, and worlds every single week.

The avatar social game where you create, hang out, and play with whoever you want, no paywall to communicate. Find your style across an ever-growing universe of fashion and social games. Whether you're here to dress up, role play, or compete in live events, this is where your creativity and your social life actually belong together.

CREATE & CUSTOMIZE YOUR AVATAR
Start with your avatar and go wherever your imagination takes you. Pick from over 1 million fashion items: outfits, hairstyles, accessories, all of it, and build a look that's completely yours. Streetwear, fantasy, anime, luxury, dark academia — the style is up to you. New drops land every week, so there's always something fresh to add.

PLAY SOCIAL GAMES WITH FRIENDS
Highrise isn't just an avatar creator. It's a social game with a lot going on. Hop into rooms where players are hosting fashion shows, talent competitions, trivia nights, and casual hangouts. Jump into minigames, show up for weekly events, and grab exclusive rewards. Every room is its own multiplayer game: new faces, new energy, all in real time.

CHAT, CONNECT & SOCIALIZE
Text chat, voice chat, avatar emotes — however you like to communicate, Highrise has you covered. Hang out across thousands of social rooms or start your own corner of the world. Follow players you vibe with, grow your community, and share life on the social Feed. Finding your people here doesn't take long. This isn't just a chat game — it's where real friendships happen.

EXPLORE A VIRTUAL WORLD OF POSSIBILITIES
Millions of player-created rooms, with new ones going up every day. Cozy hangout spots, elaborate role play worlds, party rooms, chill vibes — there's always somewhere new to land. Highrise blends life simulation with social gaming in a way that's hard to put down. Design your own rooms, shape your virtual life, and make this metaverse yours.

A SAFER PLACE TO BE YOURSELF
Moderation runs around the clock to keep rooms welcoming. Block, mute, and report any time. Voice chat, DMs, and rooms have safety controls built in, with extra protections for younger players.

quotes.text:
Highrise (YC S18) - Durham, North Carolina & Zagreb, Croatia | Senior Android Developer | ONSITE | Full-time | Relocation to Durham | jobs@high.rs | The next Facebook will be a virtual world

Highrise is the leading virtual world on iOS. We're backed by YC and leading investors. Every day, over 100,000 people use our application to make friends, keep in touch, decorate avatars and rooms, and chat. We're building a new application that builds upon our deep knowledge of avatars and games.

As Senior Android Developer, you'll work closely with our CTO and Head of Mobile to lead Highrise on Android. Our CTO built Highrise (https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/highrise-virtual-world/id924589795?mt=8) from the ground up, and our Head of Mobile was VP Eng at Ticketmaster Mobile, where he built dozens of mobile apps. You'll work with them to develop a unique 3-layered mobile infrastructure - C++ business logic layer, Cocos2dX game engine layer, and native (Java/Kotlin) UI layer. The objective is to combine gaming and social tech to build a new kind of social platform on mobile.

To apply, email jobs@high.rs.
